exploit_name: Bypass of staking restrictions via cross-chain composer
description: Cross-chain deposit flow lacks validation of restriction roles. While SOFT_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE prevents local staking, the OFT adapter path through LayerZero bypasses these checks.
root_cause: Cross-chain deposit flow lacks validation of restriction roles. While SOFT_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE prevents local staking, the OFT adapter path through LayerZero bypasses these checks.
fix_description: Validate the _depositor parameter in _depositAndSend() before calling VAULT.deposit().
notes: Restricted users can still stake by going through cross-chain wiTry flow, circumventing regulatory restrictions.
